summary_rationale: ZF Steering Gear (India) Ltd holds a durable ~90% domestic M&HCV and tractor steering duopoly alongside ZF Rane Automotive India, backed by sticky multi-year OEM platform validations, strong working-capital compression (from 66 days in FY2024 to 21 days in FY2026), and healthy operating cash conversion (₹98 Cr CFO in FY2026, 145% pre-tax CFO/EBITDA). However, business quality is rated CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than COMPOUNDER_PASS because consolidated ROCE (6.48%) and ROE (3.29%; 5.21% 3-year average) sit well below domestic cost of capital, heavy backward-integration and non-steering capex at DriveSys (Supa aluminium/solar frames) and Metacast Auto (Kolhapur foundry) has produced three consecutive years of negative Free Cash Flow (FY2024–FY2026) while lifting borrowings to ₹165 Cr and CWIP to ₹103 Cr as of September 2026, and Bosch's 2023 exit leaves the company without a global Tier-1 partner just as rival Rane deepens its 2025 Electric Power Steering collaboration with ZF.
